tasks.spec: MODE=both ECP_LLM_INTENT=authoritative ECP_LLM_MODEL_ID=us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -u /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT5/t5-eval-builder/eval_ext.py /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1r3/t1-final-analysis/eval_cases.json > haiku.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep '^TOTAL' haiku.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: c=$(grep -cE '^CASE=' haiku.txt); [ "$c" -ge 20 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $c CASE lines"; tail -6 haiku.txt; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^TOTAL mode=raw' haiku.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no raw TOTAL'; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^TOTAL mode=llm model=us.anthropic.claude-haiku' haiku.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no Haiku llm TOTAL'; exit 1; }; m=$(grep -oE '^TOTAL mode=llm.*median_lat_ms=[0-9]+' haiku.txt | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" -ge 300 ] || { echo "FAIL: llm median latency ${m}ms is too fast to be a real Bedrock call - the LLM layer is still gated off or erroring instantly"; grep -m3 'mode=llm' haiku.txt; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep '^TOTAL' haiku.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
tasks.verified: The corpus scored through Haiku 4.5 with the intent layer actually enabled (ECP_LLM_INTENT=authoritative), proven live by a Bedrock-plausible median latency, alongside the raw-path baseline.

tasks.spec: MODE=llm ECP_LLM_INTENT=authoritative MODEL_CANDIDATES=us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-20251101-v1:0,us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -u /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT5/t5-eval-builder/eval_ext.py /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1r3/t1-final-analysis/eval_cases.json > sonnet.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^MODEL_USED|^MODEL_PROBE|^TOTAL' sonnet.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -qE '^MODEL_USED=us.anthropic.claude-sonnet' sonnet.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no Sonnet-class model responded to the probe - if MODEL_PROBE_FAILED, local AWS credentials may lack access to Sonnet on Bedrock:'; head -6 sonnet.txt; exit 1; }; c=$(grep -cE '^CASE=.*mode=llm' sonnet.txt); [ "$c" -ge 10 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $c llm CASE lines"; tail -6 sonnet.txt; exit 1; }; m=$(grep -oE '^TOTAL mode=llm.*median_lat_ms=[0-9]+' sonnet.txt | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" -ge 300 ] || { echo "FAIL: llm median latency ${m}ms too fast to be real Bedrock calls"; grep -m3 'mode=llm' sonnet.txt; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 '^MODEL_USED' sonnet.txt); $(grep -m1 '^TOTAL' sonnet.txt)"
tasks.verified: The same corpus scored through a Sonnet-class phrase-picker with the intent layer enabled and Bedrock-plausible latency, completing the raw vs Haiku vs Sonnet comparison.
